events.title: Version 2.016!
events.summary: Version 2.016!​​I made some big changes to the game!Upgrade tree redesign!I redesigned the Upgrade tree! I'm not sure if it's better or worse... but it feels different to play through. I hope it's better.​​Here's the general changes with the tree: I haven't added any new upgrades, but I changed around the prices of some of the upgrades, and I moved a lot of stuff around.
